blocks.text: Ammonia is an important industrial compound of nitrogen, mainly used as a fertiliser. It is prepared industrially by the Haber-Bosch process: N2(g) + 3H2(g) in equilibrium with 2NH3(g). The next three topics treat its basicity, the structure of the ammonium ion and its laboratory synthesis from ammonium salts.

blocks.prompt: Why is ammonia manufactured on such a large scale?
blocks.explanation: Most of it goes into fertilisers, directly or as ammonium salts and urea, because plants need fixed nitrogen and cannot use the nitrogen of the air; the Haber-Bosch process converts atmospheric nitrogen and hydrogen into ammonia for this purpose.

items: NH3: industrial nitrogen compound, mainly a fertiliser; made by the Haber-Bosch process N2 + 3H2 = 2NH3.
